response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rented_films FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rating, rented_films, 1.0 * rented_films / SUM(rented_films) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), compared AS (SELECT rented_films, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM rating_shares) SELECT SUM(rented_films) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share
